name: National Securities Depository Limited
summary: National Securities Depository Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides depository services in India. It operates through Depository, Database Management Services, and Banking Services segments. It provides SPEED-e for demat account holders for direct online submission of instructions; IDeAS for viewing balances and transactions; SPICE for clearing members to submit instructions for the clients who have given power of attorney (POA) and to streamline auto pay-in instructions; and STeADY for brokers to deliver/submit electronic contract notes.
